title: Control message
description: A message on the control stream (stream 1) of a link, after the framing of file 04, section 8. Home: file 05, section 3. The three groups are control-link (file 04), control-work (file 05) and control-ckpt (file 15). Submitter messages (req, rep, event) are in submitter.1.
$comment: Before ready a message has at most 4,096 bytes; after ready 1 MiB, 4 MiB after inflation (file 05, section 10).
